note: Look variants for the M1 checkpoint (design/look.md section 8). Every value is a composite-level control the engine can switch while running. bloomWeights are the six bloom scales from finest to coarsest; bloom is their total strength. lineWidth multiplies every scene line width; poolLevel multiplies pools (glows of 16 reference pixels and up); bgLevel multiplies the background gradient and nebula. afterglowMs and afterglowStrength only show in motion (the afterglow's source and knee are in look.json and are the same for every look). 'signal' is the reference look: the engine must match design/previews/*_ref.png with it.

variants.name: Signal
variants.intent: The reference. Balanced: hot cores, coloured halos, a quiet lattice.

variants.name: Laser
variants.intent: Crisp and dark, like a vector monitor in a black room: thinner lines, tight halos, deeper blacks, short trails.

variants.name: Haze
variants.intent: Lush and saturated, like light in fog: wide soft halos, glowing clouds, colour held longer before it burns white, long trails.
